runtime.how: Press Install. It downloads the packages and model files once, onto this computer, and nothing is installed until you do.

model.name: Chatterbox voice conversion
model.needs: About 8 GB of memory is comfortable; a graphics card makes it quicker, but it also runs on the processor (Greenroom measured 36 s for an 8 s line on a processor).
model.size_note: Several gigabytes in total (the packages and the model files). It is not known exactly until it is installed.
